label: input x late in the original phase (t=4-7), in sequences that start with t, right after a 2 or u
explanation: A very sparse feature (58 active steps on dev) that fires almost only in the original phase (100% of mass) and almost always on the input token x (97% of mass, 28x lift). It fires only at steps t=4-7, peaking at t=5, and usually 0-3 tokens before <DEL>. It fires much more when the sequence starts with t (first_tok=t, 25x lift, 88% of mass) and when x comes right after a 2 (20x lift, 69% of mass) or a u. The largest activations (e.g. t o m u 2 [x]) combine all three: first token t, a recent 2 or u, and x at step 4-5. Even so, most x tokens that meet these conditions do not fire: precision is about 0.27 on dev, and loosening any condition drops precision under 3%. So the feature looks like a narrow conjunction of context and token that these variables only partly capture. It never fires in the copy phase, at t<4, or for L<=4, and it barely fires on tokens other than x (a few tiny activations on u, b, g, v).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 24 cues. Raise it: orig0=t (+3.53), prev_tok=2 (+2.13), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=x (+1.74), phase=0 & in_tok=x (+1.74), orig1=o (+1.64), prev_tok=u (+1.63). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.06), prev3_tok=- (-1.83), t=3 (-1.58), orig8=- (-0.73).
